reviews.title: Very good overall
reviews.comment: An easy to assemble and elegant tower. The magnetic clip on front covering the drawer at the bottom might strike some as a bit cheap. I recommend watching a video of it in action before making your final selection.
reviews.author: W. Cintron

reviews.title: Sleek and Sturdy Case.
reviews.comment:
Solid Case! Sleek and very accessible. I enjoyed the many places I could put my drives. Its spacious inside, and was the exact look I wanted outside. Good for an out-of-the-way tower. I bought the solid side panel. Both side panels are identical.
Great on a budget. Comes with screws. +3 fans.
It seems they scratch easy, though it may have been shipped that way. But it's not that big a deal to me because my towers are footrests that happen to run cyberpunk (I cannot remember when the scratch appeared).
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: Great case, make sure you pick up a USB c cable though
reviews.comment:
The perfect case for someone who doesn't like RGB.
Isn't flashy with a minimal design.
Even includes a small storage drawer on the front to hold my spare parts and USB drives.
Removable dust filters make regular cleaning easy as well.
Was disappointed about the lack of included USB-C cable connection. If you're going to include the port, I would expect the cable to make it functional to be provided just like the others.
reviews.author: Carrie

reviews.title: Great design and construction
reviews.comment: Amazing case, both design and features. Great build quality, easy to assemble, and has been a real workhorse for over a year. Had no trouble with my ATX build.
reviews.author: SB

reviews.title: 5.25 bays for HTPC
reviews.comment: Love the case for the front 5.25 bays. Makes for a great HTPC case to play blurays and have a usb hub for wired gaming controllers. Airflow is good. Pretty easy to clean. Like the option to NOT have a glass side panel but still get Fractal's fit and finish quality for a good price.
reviews.author: Nathan E. Pose
